But pay attention to recent moves—some of these might just be stair-stepping their way higher. Late entries? Only if names are holding above their breakout levels. And we’ve got no double-down alerts today, but anything could change fast.

So, what’s next? Keep your eyes glued to how the crypto crew behaves. $COIN and $ETHA have been lighting the path—will they keep leading? And then there’s uranium and rare earths. The $UUUU, $UEC, and $MP trifecta might be early innings of a bigger shift. We’re watching for fresh sparks there. Lastly, energy remains a wildcard. $OXY’s got room, and $APA might wake up. By the close today, we’ll know whether this market wants to cool off for the weekend or take a leg higher into next week. Stay sharp—quiet markets have a way of surprising us when we least expect it.
